description: Defines the DeliveryPerson class extending Employee, representing delivery personnel with specific attributes like vehicle number, driving license number, and city.

classes.name: DeliveryPerson
classes.description: Represents a delivery person with vehicle and licensing details extending Employee class.

methods.name: DeliveryPerson (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a DeliveryPerson with identification and vehicle details, calling the superclass constructor.

methods.name: getVehicleNum
methods.description: Returns the vehicle number assigned to the delivery person.

methods.name: setVehicleNum
methods.description: Sets the vehicle number for the delivery person.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseNum
methods.description: Returns the driving license number of the delivery person.

methods.name: setDrivingLicenseNum
methods.description: Sets the driving license number for the delivery person.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city where the delivery person operates.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city for the delivery person's operation.
